segments.text: [soft, slow, warm voice] [quiet starship ventilation hum] [softly] Lie down, support the body, and settle the temperature around you. Imagine entering the sleep deck of a starship travelling on automatic.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Feel the complete outline of the body. The ship is moving, but you have no controls to operate for a while.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Right thumb... index... middle... ring... little finger... palm... back of hand... wrist. Each panel turns from blue to dark.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Right forearm... elbow... upper arm... shoulder... armpit... ribs... waist... hip.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Right thigh... kneecap... back of knee... shin... calf... ankle... heel... sole... top of foot... each of the five toes.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Left thumb... index... middle... ring... little finger... palm... back of hand... wrist.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Left forearm... elbow... upper arm... shoulder... armpit... ribs... waist... hip.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Left thigh... kneecap... back of knee... shin... calf... ankle... heel... sole... top of foot... each of the five toes.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Both heels... calves... backs of knees... backs of thighs... pelvis... lower back... middle back... upper back... shoulder blades.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Lower belly... navel... upper belly... lower ribs... chest... collarbones... throat. The central deck grows quiet.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Jaw hinge... chin... lower lip... upper lip... corners of mouth... teeth... gums... tongue... root of the tongue. Let the mouth rest completely.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Cheeks... nose... nostrils... bridge... space around the eyes... eyelids... tiny muscles beneath the eyes.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Right eyebrow... left eyebrow... space between them... forehead... temples... ears... back of head... crown... whole scalp.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Feel the entire face powered down without disappearing. Breathing and swallowing can continue by themselves.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Whole right side... whole left side... both together... whole back... whole front... complete body inside the sleep deck.
[soft, slow, warm voice] [thoughtfully] A thought may cross the monitoring screen. Let automatic systems handle it without waking the crew.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Rest as one field of sensation suspended among distant stars.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Sense the breath entering and leaving the complete body, with no part needing to assist.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Remember the real room around you and the ordinary planet supporting everything.
[soft, slow, warm voice] [softly] Bring movement to fingers, toes, face, and limbs. Open your eyes when ready; the ship has carried you home.
